description: Image Description: The image displays a single, handwritten digit "6" in black ink on a white background. The stroke appears to be continuous, with a slight variation in thickness, suggesting it was drawn with a pen or similar writing instrument. The background is plain and uncluttered, ensuring the digit is the sole focus
